messages.body_plain:
You just need to add `inherit.aes=FALSE` to your last command:

messages.subject: verbose=F for geom_cladelabel
messages.body_plain:
Hi Guangchuang,
Would it be possible to add an argument like verbose=F to functions like geom_cladelabel? This because when using knitr and rmarkdown, the rendered document always prints out the mapping info which I don't need to see, even when message=F, warning=F, and echo=F are included in the markdown chunk arguments. Or is there a way already to do this that I am missing?
Thanks for any help,
Ricardo

How do you make a legend for nodepies?

>From the vignette:
```
set.seed(2015-12-31)
tr <- rtree(15)
p <- ggtree(tr)

a <- runif(14, 0, 0.33)

c <- runif(14, 0, 0.33)
d <- 1 - a - b - c
dat <- data.frame(a=a, b=b, c=c, d=d)
## input data should have a column of `node` that store the node number
dat$node <- 15+1:14

pies <- nodepie(dat, cols=1:4, alpha=.6)
inset(p, pies)
```

p <- ggplot(ny, aes(long, lat, group=group)) +
    geom_polygon(colour='black', fill=NA) +
    theme_bw() +
    annotation_custom(grob = leg1, xmin = -77.5, xmax = -78.5, ymin = 44, ymax = 45)
